issues.legal_issue: An allottee may be permitted to retain a plot despite having accepted a refund where the authority later delivered possession and substantial construction followed, subject to payment at the prevailing authority rate.
material_facts: The allottee accepted a refund of the amounts paid for the plot while his consumer complaint was pending, and that fact was not disclosed to the forum before it ordered re-allotment.

While the authority’s appeal against that order was pending, the authority regularized the allotment, delivered possession, and issued certificates and approvals despite the appeal and the subsequent setting aside of the forum’s order.
The allottee had paid the original plot cost and had put up substantial construction on the plot.
The authority supplied information about its prevailing rate for the plot, and the Court directed retention subject to payment at that rate after adjustment of amounts already deposited.
issues.conclusion: The impugned orders were set aside, and the authority was directed to permit the allottee to retain the plot on payment of the prevailing authority rate, after adjustment of amounts already deposited.
issues.legal_principle: Considering the circumstances and in the interest of justice, the Court granted retention subject to payment at the prevailing authority rate. It relied on the allottee’s prior payment, the authority’s delivery of possession and issuance of approvals while its appeal was pending, and the substantial construction. No statutory provision or earlier case was cited for this direction.

rule.if: consumer_appeal and refund_accepted and authority_delivered_possession_during_appeal and substantial_construction_exists and prior_plot_payment_made and prevailing_authority_rate_identified

predicates.consumer_appeal: The proceeding is an appeal arising from a consumer dispute decision concerning an allotment.
predicates.refund_accepted: The allottee accepted a refund of amounts paid for the plot.
predicates.authority_delivered_possession_during_ap: The authority delivered possession of the plot while its appeal against an order concerning the allotment was pending.
predicates.substantial_construction_exists: The allottee had put up substantial construction on the plot.
predicates.prior_plot_payment_made: The allottee had paid amounts toward the original cost of the plot.
predicates.prevailing_authority_rate_identified: The authority provided a prevailing rate for the plot.

issues.definition: When an allottee in a consumer appeal has accepted a refund but the authority delivers possession during its appeal, substantial construction exists, prior plot payment was made, and a prevailing authority rate is identified, retention may be permitted subject to payment at that rate.

issues.legal_issue: An authority must take action in accordance with law against officials responsible for lapses in handling an allotment while proceedings concerning it are pending.
material_facts: The authority regularized the allotment, delivered possession, and issued certificates and approvals while its appeal was pending and after the order supporting the allotment had been set aside.
The Court ordered an inquiry into those events and the identification of responsible officials.
The authority later filed a response identifying officials responsible for lapses and describing the action taken.
issues.conclusion: The authority was directed to proceed in accordance with law against the responsible officials and to file a compliance report on the disciplinary proceedings.
issues.legal_principle: After directing an inquiry into the authority’s actions during pending proceedings and considering the authority’s response identifying officials responsible for lapses, the Court directed the authority to pursue action against them in accordance with law. No statutory provision or earlier case was cited for this direction.

predicates.consumer_appeal: The proceeding is an appeal arising from a consumer dispute decision concerning an allotment.
predicates.authority_actions_conflicted_with_pendin: The authority took actions concerning the allotment that were inconsistent with the status of proceedings then pending or orders already made in those proceedings.
predicates.responsible_officials_identified: An inquiry or response identified officials responsible for lapses in those actions.

issues.definition: When an authority takes actions concerning an allotment that conflict with pending proceedings and an inquiry identifies responsible officials, the authority must take lawful action against those officials.
